'''Waterfall Giant''' is a {{2|Bosses|Boss}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Waterfall Giant}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Pressurize
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains (15;{{Asc2|9|20}}) {{BD2|Steam Eruption}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Steam Eruption
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Stomp
|Intent = Attack3, Debuff, Buff
|Effect = Deals (15;{{Asc2|9|16}}) damage. Applies 1 {{BD2|Weak}}. Gains 3 {{BD2|Steam Eruption}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Steam Eruption
|GivesToPlayer = Weak
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Ram
|Intent = Attack3, Buff
|Effect = Deals (10;{{Asc2|9|11}}) damage. Gains 3 {{BD2|Steam Eruption}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Steam Eruption
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Siphon
|Intent = Heal, Buff
|Effect = Heals (10;{{Asc2|8|15}}) HP per player. Gains 3 {{BD2|Steam Eruption}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Steam Eruption, Heal
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Pressure Gun
|Intent = Attack4, Buff
|Effect = Deals (20;{{Asc2|9|23}}) damage (increases by 5 each use). Gains 3 {{BD2|Steam Eruption}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Steam Eruption
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Pressure Up
|Intent = Attack3, Buff
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|14}}) damage. Gains 3 {{BD2|Steam Eruption}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Steam Eruption
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = About To Blow
|Intent = Stun
|Effect = Becomes invulnerable. Removes {{BD2|Steam Eruption}} and prepares to explode.
|GivesToEnemy = Steam Eruption
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Explode
|Intent = DeathBlow
|Effect = Deals damage equal to its stored {{BD2|Steam Eruption}} amount, then dies.
|GivesToEnemy = Steam Eruption
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Waterfall Giant uses {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Pressurize}} on its first turn, then follows a repeating cycle:
# {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Stomp}}
# {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Ram}}
# {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Siphon}}
# {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Pressure Gun}}
# {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Pressure Up}}
# Back to {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Stomp}}

Almost every move also adds 3 {{BD2|Steam Eruption}}. When the Waterfall Giant is killed while it has {{BD2|Steam Eruption}}, it becomes invulnerable and uses {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|About To Blow}}, cleansing all its buffs and debuffs. Next turn it will use {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Explode}}, dealing damage equal to its accumulated {{BD2|Steam Eruption}} before dying.

* If the Waterfall Giant is killed when it has no {{BD2|Steam Eruption}} (e.g. via {{BD2|Doom}}), it dies normally without triggering the explosion sequence.

== Notes ==
* Even though the HP bar in the last phase shows as "infinity", it is actually set to the finite number of 999,999,999 HP. As such, it is theoretically possible to kill the Waterfall Giant in its last phase.
* If a card both deals damage and applies a debuff like {{C2|Neutralize}}, the damage can kill the '''Waterfall Giant''' and activate {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|About To Blow}}, then the debuff will be applied.

== Useful Cards ==

* Even if you can defeat the '''Waterfall Giant''', its final {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Explode}} move can still easily kill you. Strong block cards like {{C2|Blood Wall}} or {{C2|Leg Sweep}} can be played on the final turn to block some of the damage from the explosion.
* Increasing the block density of your deck over the course of the battle makes it less likely that you will draw a hand full of non-block cards when the '''Waterfall Giant''' uses {{Int2|Waterfall Giant|Explode}}. Cards like {{C2|Burning Pact}} and {{C2|BEGONE!}} can be used to remove non-block cards like {{C2|Strike (Ironclad)|Strike}}.
* {{C2|Anger}} can be dangerous to play during this battle, as it increases the number of attack cards in your deck and makes it more likely that you will end up with few or no block cards on the final turn.
* Necrobinder's Summon cards, such as {{C2|Bodyguard}} and {{C2|Afterlife}}, can use Osty to block damage on the final turn no matter which cards you happen to draw.
* Cards like {{C2|Well-Laid Plans}} and {{C2|Convergence}} can hold block cards in hand to save them for the final turn.
